topic: Functional components of three axis FCS
syllabus_extract: Functional components of three axis FCS.
specific_objectives: 14.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the functions of AFCS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of AFCS block diagrams and signal flow paths from IB; Instructor supervision required for schematic interpretation.
intro_questions: What are the three primary axes of aircraft rotation?
List two basic control surfaces associated with pitch and roll.

development.content:
Definition and scope of AFCS
Three-axis control architecture
Sensors and data acquisition
Control law logic
Actuator types and response

Pitch axis component breakdown
Roll axis component breakdown
Yaw axis component breakdown
Integration of axis functions
Feedback loop mechanisms

Mode selection and engagement
Fail-safe mechanisms overview
Interface with flight instruments
Summary of functional hierarchy
Key terminology review

summary_questions: Explain the specific function of the yaw damper within the three-axis FCS.
Describe how the AFCS integrates data from multiple sensors to maintain stability.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the interlock requirements for the AFCS, referencing the schematic to be studied in Lesson Plan 19.

pft_rows.syllabus: Need for interlock in AFCS and explanation with schematic.
